d=pq.read_table('data/test-00000-of-00001.parquet').to_pandas()
tok=re.compile(r"[\w']+|[.,!?;:()\"$%&/-]")
forms={'raw':[' '.join(t.split()) for t in d.text],
 'lower':[' '.join(t.lower().split()) for t in d.text],
 'unesc_lower':[' '.join(html.unescape(t).replace('\\n',' ').lower().split()) for t in d.text],
 'norm':[' '.join(tok.findall(html.unescape(t).replace('\\n',' ').lower())) for t in d.text]}
for f in sys.argv[1:]:
    m=fasttext.load_model(f); out=[f]
    for k,v in forms.items():
        p=[int(x[0][9:]) for x in m.predict(v)[0]]
        out.append('%s=%.4f'%(k,sum(int(a==b) for a,b in zip(p,d.label))/len(p)))
    print(*out,flush=True)

free -g; cd /app && cat > big.py <<'EOF'
import fasttext,os,re,html,pyarrow.parquet as pq,sys
kw=eval(sys.argv[1])
m=fasttext.train_supervised('train_mix.txt',thread=os.cpu_count(),verbose=1,**kw)
d=pq.read_table('data/test-00000-of-00001.parquet').to_pandas()
tok=re.compile(r"[\w']+|[.,!?;:()\"$%&/-]")
forms={'raw':[' '.join(t.split()) for t in d.text],
 'lower':[' '.join(t.lower().split()) for t in d.text],
 'norm':[' '.join(tok.findall(html.unescape(t).replace('\\n',' ').lower())) for t in d.text]}
def ev(mm,tag):
    o=[tag]
    for k,v in forms.items():
        p=[int(x[0][9:]) for x in mm.predict(v)[0]]
        o.append('%s=%.4f'%(k,sum(int(a==b) for a,b in zip(p,d.label))/len(p)))
    print(*o,flush=True)
ev(m,'full')
m.save_model('big_full.bin'); print('full MB',os.path.getsize('big_full.bin')/1e6,flush=True)
m.quantize(qnorm=True, retrain=False)
m.save_model('big_q.bin'); print('quant MB',os.path.getsize('big_q.bin')/1e6,flush=True)
ev(m,'quant')
EOF
